coder_result.remark: Template review REJECTED due to critical metadata and naming inconsistencies. Three critical issues: (1) 02b_task_graph Doc Type mismatch ('02_plan_artifact' vs '02b_task_graph'), (2) 05_validation template uses wrong metadata format (Markdown table vs YAML frontmatter), (3) Validation ID format mismatch (VALIDATION- vs VAL-). Plus major issue: template_registry.md is incomplete (missing Validation entry). Templates cannot be approved until these structural issues are fixed.

findings.impact: Template declares 'Doc Type: 02_plan_artifact' but template_registry.md and SOP expect '02b_task_graph'. Will cause validation script failures when checking artifact type against registry.

findings.issue: Validation template uses incompatible metadata format
findings.impact: Uses Markdown table for metadata instead of YAML frontmatter. All other 7 templates use YAML frontmatter (--- delimiters). Runner and validation scripts expect YAML frontmatter; will fail to parse metadata from this template.

Template declares 'VALIDATION-{{YYYYMMDD}}-{{NN}}' but delivery_status_rules.json (Naming discipline section) specifies 'VAL-{{YYYYMMDD}}-{{NN}}'. Inconsistent naming breaks artifact registry lookups and traceability.

findings.issue: Template registry incomplete - missing Validation entry
findings.impact: Registry lists only 7 document types but 8 templates exist. Validation is missing from registry table and flow diagram. Registry is documentation of actual templates; omitting Validation indicates incomplete specification.

findings.issue: Validation template missing proper YAML frontmatter metadata fields
findings.impact: Lacks Doc Type and Template Version in YAML frontmatter. Other templates have these at top in --- block. Standard header format is missing, breaking consistency and causing runner metadata extraction to fail.

findings.issue: Inconsistent metadata field naming across templates
findings.impact: Some templates use 'Initiative ID' while others use '{{INITIATIVE_ID}}'. Field names should be consistent; only placeholder values should differ. Minor issue but indicates lack of careful template standardization.

evidence.notes: Template header line 2: 'Doc Type: 02_plan_artifact' contradicts registry entry 'Doc Type: 02b_task_graph'
Missing YAML frontmatter. Line 1 starts with '# {{TITLE}}' instead of '---' YAML marker. Compare to 01_initiative.template.md which starts with '---\nDoc Type: 01_initiative'
Status rules specify 'VAL-YYYYMMDD-NN' format for validation artifacts but template declares 'VALIDATION-{{YYYYMMDD}}-{{NN}}'
Registry document type table lists: Initiative, Plan, Task Graph, Task, Implementation Plan, Review, Memory (7 types). Validation template exists but is not listed in registry.
Directory contains 8 .template.md files: 01, 02, 02b, 03, 04_implementation_plan, 04_review, 05_validation, 06. Registry lists only 7 artifact types.
